newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit retains gains and in range on dlr support.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit retains gains and in range on dlr support.

text.p: The ringgit retained overnight gains and traded in a range due to resistance at 2.5220 a dollar level, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said the ringgit was moving up on fresh dollar selling by a Kuala Lumpur-based group.
"I think there was a Euroloan issue involved. They were selling dollar for ringgit," a dealer with a European bank in Singapore said.
"It could not have been more than a $100 million, but volume was thin, which exaggerated the movement," he said.
Earlier, dealers said some stop-losses were triggered due to the selling that started after dollar/ringgit hit 2.5310.
Another stop was triggered at 2.5250 as selling persisted.
"As a result, the dollar/ringgit was down again, triggering stop-losses at 2.5250 before coming to a halt around 2.5218/20," research firm I.D.E.A said in a note from Singapore.
"We do not expect dollar/ringgit to slip below 2.52 in the coming sessions," it said, adding 2.5220 was well supported.
Dealers said volumes were still not large and trading was largely on sentiment determined by dollar/majors.
At 0430 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5205/15 a dollar.
